messages:
ops-bot: Alert: Canary deploy v4.2 -> p99 tail latency spike detected on canary pool 'canary-eu-1'. p99 increased from 220ms to 1.9s, p95 up to 480ms. Error budget close to 90%.

alice (SRE): I'm on it. Paging @raj (oncall) and @marie. Any immediate customer pages?

raj (oncall): Got page. Looking at traces — streams show many stalled chunks, retransmits. Multiplexing queue depth climbs before stalls.

marie (eng-runtime): This started shortly after we shifted 15% traffic to v4.2 (encoder/quant-optimized). We saw cold KV cache misses on first tokens, but the pattern looks like progressive KV eviction on canary nodes.

santiago (prod-sre): Can we roll back canary traffic to previous variant while we investigate? 

alice (SRE): Propose: 1) shift canary back to v4.1 (20 mins), 2) scale canary pool +2 replicas to drain queues, 3) enable fallback to v4.1 on streaming timeouts.

marie (eng-runtime): Agree. Rollback ready. Running `redwood deploy rollback --pool canary-eu-1 --to v4.1 --reason=p99-tail-spike` now. Logs: `rollback initiated -> 3/3 nodes ack`.

ops-bot: ACTION: Traffic shift started at canary-eu-1: 15% -> 0% (via mux rule). ETA 30s.

raj (oncall): Observing metrics... p99 dropping to ~350ms within 90s. Streaming stalls reduced. Good signal.

support-bot: Customer impact check: 2 customers reported degraded interactive sessions in last 30m (ticket #C-5921, #C-5926). Both affected by streaming stalls; no data loss reported.

alice (SRE): Notify CS to update customers: temporary regression during canary, rollback in progress, mitigation applied. Drafting message.

marie (eng-runtime): Captured heap and KV stats from the canary nodes. KV miss ratio spiked to 62% and cache churn high. Suspect new model tokenization increased prefix diversity causing cache thrash.

santiago (prod-sre): For follow-up: add canary warmup (prefix replay) and KV pinning during rollout. Also need a safety rule: if p99 > 800ms for >5min, auto-fallback.

raj (oncall): Handing off to santiago for next steps and postmortem. My console: `oncall:ack` (reaction :white_check_mark:). I'll stay available if needed.

santiago (prod-sre): Taking over. Will run kv snapshot diff and schedule postmortem. Assigning to @marie for root cause + PR for warmup. @alice please file incident with timeline and customer impact.

alice (SRE): Created incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/4498765432 (internal). Summary saved; will include metrics, rollout commands, tickets.

ops-bot: RESOLUTION: Canary rollback to v4.1 completed at ts 4498765980. p99 stabilized at 260ms. Incident downgraded to SEV3.

support-bot: CS notif sent to affected customers: status update and apology; offer follow-up when postmortem ready.

santiago (prod-sre): Closing handoff notes: temp mitigation = rollback + scale. Next actions = warmup tooling, KV pin heuristics, canary safety rule. Will schedule postmortem cadence.

raj (oncall): thx all. :thumbsup:
